title: Christmas on a Houseboat
closingNote: Every door is open, {name}. The water has frozen, the lanterns are glowing, and the star is lit. Merry Christmas.

doors.body: Welcome aboard, {name}. The backwaters are warm tonight, and every lantern is lit for you.
Open the shutters and look out. The palms lean over the water as if they were listening.
Tea is better when the water is still. Pour a cup and stay a while.
One small light is enough to find your way. This one is yours.
Some things are kept for exactly the right moment. This was one of them.
If the world ever feels too deep, hold on to the people who would swim out to you.
Roll the blind up. The evening has changed colour while you were busy.
A letter, just for you. It says what it always says: I am glad you exist.
Something warm from the kitchen. It smells like home, doesn't it?
Lift the lid. Steam, and the first good thing of the week.
A basket of small joys. Take one now and save the rest.
Cast a net wide enough and the day brings something kind.
Slide it open. Cold air at last. Winter is on its way.
Draw the curtain back. You are exactly where you should be.
Every drawer holds something you forgot you loved.
A little shelf to rest your cup on. Sit here for a moment.
Whichever way you turn, you will find your way home.
A secret way down. There is always one more room than you expect.
Step out onto the upper deck. Look how far you can see.
Slide the shutter aside. The mist is lifting.
Cracked open on a cold night. Sweet, and unexpected.
A little boat, just big enough for a secret. Here it is.
A message in a bottle: this was written for you, {name}, long before you opened it.
The star is lit. Thank you for opening every door. Merry Christmas, {name}.
